header: - **Build:** `4a427fc05f829d7b2e4ed7ea642d77340554f7f8` (main), detached worktree `/workspace/wt-promo-v1-1004`, `vite build` + `vite preview` on 127.0.0.1:6460. No app code changed.

- **Capture:** headless Chrome via Playwright, Playwright clock paused and stepped 1/60 s per frame, CSS/WAAPI animations seeked to virtual time (scripts in `capture/commission-ai/`). Dark theme. Capture-only CSS: `cursor:none` on every take; `NO_TOASTS` (Sonner toaster hidden) on every `pshots.mjs` take (shots 03c/04/05/06/08/10/11/12/15pr/talk-dag); `HIDE_MONEY` (wallet/mora figures hidden) on the `w14b.mjs` Workshop takes (shot-14b*); none on the `wshots.mjs` standalone Workshop takes. Per clip: `inject` in notes.json / `<clip>.meta.json`, recorded in manifest.yaml `capture` (+ `framing` for HIDE_MONEY / overlay).
- **Masters:** `.mov` H.264 lossless (`-qp 0`, yuv444p) 1920x1080 60 fps. `-preview.mp4` H.264 crf 16 yuv420p. Sound off.

- **Framing:** 'full' = 1920x1080 CSS at DPR 1. 'clip' = a CSS rectangle of the normal 1920x1080 CSS layout rendered at deviceScaleFactor 2 and scaled to 1920x1080 output (crisp, pre-framed). For the 4K pass use the same CSS rect at DPR 4 (or full frames at 1920x1080 CSS DPR 2).

- **Cursor:** no OS cursor (headless) and `cursor:none` capture CSS on every take. The capture-overlay arrow (a DOM element following the real pointer, `CURSOR` in pshots.mjs) is injected only in shot 10 (`shot-10`, `shot-10-dpr2`). Shots 11, 12, 05-rail (and 03c, 14b) use real pointer clicks/moves but draw no cursor.
